results.content: ENRD’s litigators have also had their hands full defending the administration’s climate initiatives against legal challenge and supporting agencies in undoing the previous administration’s environmental rollbacks—while ensuring these steps abide by the Administrative Procedure Act. Under Kim’s leadership, ENRD has worked closely with Attorney General Merrick Garland in developing a recently announced, comprehensive strategy to guide the work of all DOJ components to “ensure that the department is using every available tool to secure environmental justice for everyone.” In particular, this initiative includes creation of a new Office of Environmental Justice within ENRD, as well as a renewed focus on civil rights statutes, such as Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibits recipients of federal funding from discriminating on the basis of race, color, or national origin.
